title: Plan SHOW INDEXES SQL metadata command
problem: FusionDB stores index metadata for CREATE INDEX and DROP INDEX, but users cannot inspect existing indexes through SQL.
approach: Route SHOW INDEXES and SHOW INDEXES FROM <table> through the custom execute_sql path.
Scan index_meta:<index_name> records and decode table/column metadata without touching table data.
Return stable Index, Table, Column columns and sort rows by index name for deterministic tests.
Verify SHOW INDEXES before and after DROP INDEX.
expected_impact: Improves SQL observability for index lifecycle operations.
Adds a cheap metadata-only path with no dashboard changes.
risk_controls: Keep implementation read-only and scoped to existing index_meta records.
Do not change CREATE INDEX, DROP INDEX, planner, storage, dashboard, or UI behavior.
